findings.description: Dutta, Sourav is listed in the ECE department's tenure-system faculty roster. His own ECE profile confirms assistant professor; the directory link misroutes to Babak Fahimi.

Rohrer, Ronald is listed in the ECE department's affiliated faculty roster. His Materials Science and Engineering profile specifically calls his current UT Dallas appointment Research Professor, which is excluded under the policy despite the ECE affiliated list.

All five ECE department category lists were enumerated; no missing listed person was identified. Search for announced incoming professors found no current qualifying announcement; the search does not prove no unannounced appointment exists.
Yue Zhou central profile identifies associate professor while ECE affiliated list says professor; rank discrepancy does not alter eligibility.
